summary: Fail closed on unsupported numeric answer claims and reuse settled question tasks across repeated-whitespace variants.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued project accuracy and efficiency across RFI, Submittal and Email content
An exact quotation contract still accepted a 4-inch conclusion cited only to a 2-inch source
Repeated whitespace did not change retrieval semantics but generated a second paid task
approval_evidence: The user's persistent objective explicitly authorizes continued efficiency and accuracy improvements for project-file workflows.
known_limitations: Numeric grounding catches explicit literal disagreement but does not validate surrounding prose, written-out numbers, unit conversions or contractual authority.
Cache normalization intentionally excludes letter case, punctuation and semantic paraphrases; those remain distinct explicit submissions to protect case-sensitive identifiers.
Validation uses synthetic offline evidence and does not establish construction accuracy on customer documents.
